title: Don Byas and Django Reinhardt with the band
summary: Greer recalls hiring Don Byas as guest in Europe and bringing Django Reinhardt to Carnegie Hall.

bands.name: Quintette du Hot Club de France

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: We went to Europe and Duke hired Don Byas just as a guest soloist. He played -- what's that song -- "Oh, Danny Boy." In four different tempos. Kill you. Don Byas, he was my running mate. He'd say, man -- he lived in Europe. "Man, you --
He was fine. But he was -- he wasn't no bigger than me. Something else, he was something else, man. Yeah, Django Reinhardt --
Yeah, Django Reinhardt played in the band.

We brought him from Europe. First time ever in America, played at Carnegie Hall. The gypsy, from the French Hot Five. --man, that cat and guitars, make it talk. Nobody played like -- only had three fingers on one of his hands.
Bov, but that cat, oh, God. He was something else.
What kind of a guy was he? Did he speak much English?
